title: Tightening Orbit Helm
summary: Medium Armour headwear with +1 Constitution saves and a Force Conduit pull.

fields.Saving throws: +1 Constitution saving throws. Medium Armour proficiency.
fields.Tightening Orbit: Level 3 Action, once per Short Rest. Spend 1 turn of Force Conduit and pull enemies within 30 ft toward you. The spell describes damaging force but gives no damage dice, save, or pull distance.
fields.Base value: No nominal BG3 value is listed in the pinned source.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
